model_system: AV3Sb5 kagome metals (A=Cs,Rb,K), modeled by a 9-band kagome-layer tight-binding model with two coupled van Hove singularities near M

key_params.order_parameter: Delta_AB=Delta_BC=Delta_CA≡Delta (complex); Re Delta = charge bond order, Im Delta = loop current order
key_params.effective_basis: u1(MA), u1(MB), u1(MC), u2(MA), u2(MB), u2(MC) for vH1 and vH2
key_params.vHS_coupling: lambda, linear-in-k inter-vHS coupling at same M point

headline_claim: For coupled van Hove singularities with small separation, LCBO is lower in energy than CBO−; quantitatively, f_CBO− − f_LCBO > 0 with the explicit expression above, and LCBO is favored when delta_epsilon < 4(|b|^2+|b'|^2)|Delta|.
replication_difficulty: medium-high + requires reconstructing the DFT-fitted 9-band TB parameters and self-consistent mean-field/patch-model comparison from the paper/SM
